description: Download finished clip files to the user's ~/Downloads folder — the marquee local-disk feature a hosted MCP cannot do. Use after a job is complete when the user wants the actual .mp4 files. Pass clip_index (1-based) to grab one clip, or omit it to download all clips from the job. Files over 500MB are skipped for safety.

clip_index.description: 1-based index of a single clip to download. Omit to download every clip in the job.

name: download_clip
